results.question: v_order_revenue üzerinden ülke bazında ciro
results.sql:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.country,
    SUM(orv.total_revenue) AS total_country_revenue
FROM order_revenue orv
JOIN customers c ON orv.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_country_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50

results.question: Ankara'daki müşterilere ait gecikmiş faturalar
results.sql:
WITH delayed_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.invoice_id,
        i.invoice_date,
        i.due_date,
        i.gross_amount,
        i.remaining_amount,
        i.status,
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_name,
        ca.city
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN sales_orders so ON i.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON so.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN customer_addresses ca ON c.customer_id = ca.customer_id
    WHERE ca.city = 'Ankara'
      AND ca.is_primary = true
      AND i.status IN ('pending', 'overdue')
      AND i.remaining_amount > 0
      AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
)
SELECT
    invoice_id,
    customer_name,
    invoice_date,
    due_date,
    gross_amount,
    remaining_amount,
    status
FROM delayed_invoices
ORDER BY due_date ASC
LIMIT 50
